headline: The hour folds its own light.
body: A radiator ticks in a room that has not been entered. The streetlamp across the way has begun to look tired of its post. We note it because the desk does not sleep.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: thin cloud, sodium bleed at the edges

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: one cyclist, no lights, pavement still wet
